selected_evidence.summary: Wrote blacklist config, ran update-initramfs, and confirmed modprobe -n -v usb_storage resolves to the /bin/true stub and the module is not in lsmod.

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy pre-restart baseline with boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-reboot boot_id (e4e401d2-3dd8-48c6-848a-545631b9e229) and confirmed usb_storage still blocked/unloaded before restart.
Backgrounded 'sleep 2; reboot' via sudo -n returned its acknowledgement immediately, before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof node actually restarted (changed boot identity)
selected_evidence.summary: First poll showed unchanged boot_id (not yet rebooted), second poll hit connection-refused mid-reboot, third poll succeeded with a new boot_id (19314f32-5049-4381-8b17-76eb20b28120), proving a real restart occurred.
Post-reboot check confirms blacklist config file intact, usb_storage not loaded, and modprobe -n -v usb_storage still resolves to the /bin/true stub.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== baseline: module loaded? =="
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "not currently loaded"

echo "== step 1: blacklist conf =="
printf 'blacklist usb-storage\ninstall usb-storage /bin/true\n' | sudo tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf

echo "== step 2: remove module if loaded =="
sudo modprobe -r usb_storage 2>&1 || echo "modprobe -r: not loaded or removal not needed"

echo "== step 3: update initramfs so blacklist applies at boot =="
if command -v update-initramfs >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo update-initramfs -u
elif command -v dracut >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo dracut -f
else
  echo "no initramfs tool found"
fi

echo "== verify: modprobe config =="
cat /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf

echo "== verify: currently loaded modules =="
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "confirmed: usb_storage not loaded"

echo "== verify: modprobe -n -v simulated load =="
sudo modprobe -n -v usb_storage || true
